title: Strings Differ by One Character
description:
Given a list of strings `dict` where all the strings are of the same length.

Return `true` if there are 2 strings that only differ by 1 character in the same index, otherwise return `false`.

examples.explanation: Strings "abcd" and "aacd" differ only by one character in the index 1.

constraints: The number of characters in dict <= 10^5
dict[i] contains only lowercase English letters.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Strings Differ by One Character.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
